title: Review Percentage for the Initial Late Fee — Apartment Home Lease Training Note
content:
Under a late fee review of an Apartment Home Lease, the review percentage follows the lateness record: a lease with no earlier late period in the review look-back and no returned payment in the last 12 months has a review percentage of 0.040; a lease with exactly one earlier late period in the review look-back and no returned payment in the last 12 months has a review percentage of 0.045; any other lease keeps the floor plan's initial late fee percentage.

## Questions answered

**What is an earlier late period?** Another billing period carrying an initial late fee line dated in the review look-back. The reviewed period's own initial late fee line is not an earlier late period.

**What is a returned payment in the last 12 months?** Any payment return on the lease ledger dated after the same day of the month twelve months before the handling date, whatever its reason.

**What does the review percentage act on?** It is the percentage applied to the period's base rent line in the percentage component of the allowed initial late fee.

## Percentage table

| Earlier late periods in the review look-back | Payment return in the last 12 months | Review percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | No | 0.040 (4.0%) |
| 1 | No | 0.045 (4.5%) |
| 2 or more | No | the floor plan's initial late fee percentage |
| any | Yes | the floor plan's initial late fee percentage |

## Hypothetical figures

On a base rent line of $2,600.00: 4.0 percent is $104.00 and 4.5 percent is $117.00. On a base rent line of $3,333.33: 4.5 percent is $149.99985, which rounds half up to $150.00.
